subject: history
concept: Analyzing cross-cultural exchange along historical trade networks (Silk Road, trans-Saharan trade)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student traces a trade network route on a map, noting goods and ideas exchanged along it
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an exchanged good or idea to the regions connected by a trade network
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a described trade network affected the cultures connected by it

misconception_flags: assumes trade networks only exchanged goods and not ideas, technology, or culture

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
